task_results.title: Replace window.confirm flows with shared confirm dialog
task_results.message: Reservations, ReservationCheck ve DashboardReservations iptal akislari shared ConfirmDialogContext uzerinden modal tabanli hale getirildi.

task_results.title: Isolate browser-only modal dependencies
task_results.message: Body scroll lock ve modal history davranisi hook'lara tasindi; ilgili componentlerde dogrudan body overflow / history pushState kullanimi kaldirildi.

task_results.title: Add storage abstraction and service layer cleanup
task_results.message: Token/theme localStorage erisimi storage abstraction altina alindi; AdminPanel ve BeachSettings icindeki bare axios cagrilari adminService ve beachSettingsService uzerinden tasindi.

task_results.title: Remove targeted silent catch blocks and convert reservation steps to TSX
task_results.message: BeachSettings ve BeachDetail icindeki sessiz catch path'leri log/toast ile gorunur hale getirildi; StepDateType ve StepPayment minimal prop typing ile TSX'e tasindi.
